realmeCare - 1year Screen Damage Protection Plan for Smartphones Between Rs.30000-39999 (Email Delivery, No Physical Product)

from Service Lee Technologies Pvt. Ltd
3.3 (3)
₹1,799.00
  • WHY REALME SCREEN PROTECT: This realme Screen protection plan provides coverage which includes screen replacement due to any kind of accidental breakage or damage on the handset.
  • WHAT IS COVERED: This plan Coverage begins when the Customer purchase the Plan for his Mobile Phone (“Device”) and ends on completion of one year from the date of purchase of the Plan (“Plan Term”). This warranty is applicable only on new realme product purchased at Amazon. Only one Screen Damage Repair Request per Device is allowed during the Plan term of 12 (twelve) Months. The Plan and Phone must be bought together with New phones purchased from Amazon.
  • WHAT IS NOT COVERED? Unauthorised repair, Normal wear and tear, cosmetic damages, loss and theft of device, damage caused by intentional conduct. This plan cannot be transferred to another person.
  • HASSLE-FREE REPAIR: No documentation is required from the customer during a claim, a one time deductible of 1400 needs to be paid by the customer to the realalme Authorised Service Centre directly. Customers can cancel the policy maximum within 7 working days from the date of purchase.
  • HOW TO RAISE A CLAIM? Schedule a service at your convenience from your Amazon account itself by navigating to Your Orders section in your Amazon account > go to the product order > click on Get Product Support > schedule an appointment. We use genuine spare parts & repairs carried out through realme Authorized service centres.
  • A DIGITAL DELIVERY PRODUCT -- Your plan details will be delivered via email within 2 hours of ordering on your Amazon registered email id (No physical delivery). For any other issue, reach out to Support Email ID: service@realme.com Toll-Free Number: 1800 102 2777

      About this item

      • India's 1st 7+ Gen 3 Flagship Chipset 1.5M + AnTuTu Score,According to Qualcomm's official data, compared with Snapdragon 7+ Gen 2, CPU performance is increased by 15% and GPU performance is increased by 45%.
      • Top Battery Duo 50% Charge in 10 mins for 1-Day Use 5500mAh+120W Gallium Nitride Charger More compact in size for easy portability, with fast heat dissipation, while also offering high efficiency and high power fast charging.
      • India’s Largest Cooling System For your coolest gaming experience,To improve user thermal experience, efforts have been made in heat-generating chip layout and structural contact optimization, achieving a new generation of cooling design: effectively reducing temperature rise by 2 degrees on the side, achieving a low-temperature feel on the side frame. This results in a better sensory effect when holding.
      • The World's Brightest Flagship Display crystal clear visuals even in sunlight, 1.Uses AI models to analyze users' blinking and yawning frequency to identify fatigue, proactively adjusting color temperature and brightness for smart eye protection. 2.Eye Protection Certification: SGS AI Eye-Protection Display 3. Special Eye Protection: Paper-like eye protection, sleep mode, ambient color adaptation, DC dimming, comprehensive eye protection. Sleep mode: After sunset until before sunrise, the screen color temperature automatically adjusts to a warm hue, matching physiological rhythms to aid in sleep.
      • Segment's Only 8T LTPO,LTPO technology features adaptive frequency adjustment, allowing for frequency switching based on screen demand, lowering the refresh rate when displaying static content to reduce power consumption. The 8T LTPO technology, with its advanced pixel circuit design, achieves seamless frame rate transition, directly switching refresh rates to reduce flickering.

          5 out of 5 stars
          Awesome allrounder
          Got this for 27k on sale, after a long confusion/comparisons between OnePlus Nord 4 vs realme gt 6t vs nothing phone 2a plus, finally I picked this. I was already a realme 8s 5g user, I used it for nearly 3 years.. not much problem wasn't happened, I feel some battery draining and network issues sometimes, so I decided to change it. After a 20 days of usage, my review is 1. Display 10/10 very smooth, nice and bright, fingerprint sensor also faster. 2. Processor 10/10 very good ram management, has more features at this price range 3. Cameras 9/10 may have more features, and I m not a mobile photographer, just a regular user, so it feels good to me for daily usage, with this camera. 4. Sound quality and haptic 10/10, this is my 1st time to feel this much powerful haptics and vibration in a phone, so I m Fully satisfied with that, mic also very good, voice clarity 👍 5. Build 9/10 , totally plastic and the camera bulge is more irritating actually 6. Battery 10/10, but actually sometimes I feel a draining issue, but not so much to complaint about it, actually i m confused, may be a long time usage will tell about it, but the charging speed is very good, and the 120W charger in box with cable is also appreciable by realme, I noticed 100-90 percent tooks a lot hours to drain. But for actual routine daily usage, at the end of the day, it remain about 55 to 60 percentage,so I charge only once in a day. 7. connectivity 10/10 wifi, bluetooth, sim everything's perfect. The cons were plastic built, cameras positioning and bulge issue and unlike other phones, slightly a broader display, which may felt different to some people, and some pre-installed apps, had to turn off more options, apps notification,Suggestion ads. And sometimes felt a heating issue too, but not so much to be complaining about it. But other than that, there won't be a better performance and a power house will be available at this price range. That's for sure💯

            5 out of 5 stars
            Awesome allrounder
            Reviewed in India on 23 October 2024
            Colour: Fluid SilverSize: 8 GB RAM + 128 GB Storage
            Verified Purchase

            Got this for 27k on sale, after a long confusion/comparisons between OnePlus Nord 4 vs realme gt 6t vs nothing phone 2a plus, finally I picked this. I was already a realme 8s 5g user, I used it for nearly 3 years.. not much problem wasn't happened, I feel some battery draining and network issues sometimes, so I decided to change it.

            After a 20 days of usage, my review is

            1. Display 10/10 very smooth, nice and bright, fingerprint sensor also faster.

            2. Processor 10/10 very good ram management, has more features at this price range

            3. Cameras 9/10 may have more features, and I m not a mobile photographer, just a regular user, so it feels good to me for daily usage, with this camera.

            4. Sound quality and haptic 10/10, this is my 1st time to feel this much powerful haptics and vibration in a phone, so I m Fully satisfied with that, mic also very good, voice clarity 👍

            5. Build 9/10 , totally plastic and the camera bulge is more irritating actually

            6. Battery 10/10, but actually sometimes I feel a draining issue, but not so much to complaint about it, actually i m confused, may be a long time usage will tell about it, but the charging speed is very good, and the 120W charger in box with cable is also appreciable by realme, I noticed 100-90 percent tooks a lot hours to drain. But for actual routine daily usage, at the end of the day, it remain about 55 to 60 percentage,so I charge only once in a day.

            7. connectivity 10/10 wifi, bluetooth, sim everything's perfect.

            The cons were plastic built, cameras positioning and bulge issue and unlike other phones, slightly a broader display, which may felt different to some people, and some pre-installed apps, had to turn off more options, apps notification,Suggestion ads. And sometimes felt a heating issue too, but not so much to be complaining about it.

            But other than that, there won't be a better performance and a power house will be available at this price range. That's for sure💯

              Great curved screen and elegant design, amazing performance! Good for BGMI game to play @90fps(tested) without any lag by enabling GT mode🤩🥳

              Cameras are big and entire back looks very premium but, the brand provided case is of no use because of its big space to showcase the cameras entire area😤 it looks awkward with that case on🤮 I recommend The GiftKart liquid silicon back case(black) which costed me 299/- its a good case that provides utmost security and also proper grip, it gives a premium look and feel for the mobile by covering all the unnecessary gaps..

              I am glad that I have availed the discount coupon of 7k that was available for some period on amazon and bought the mobile for ₹23,998/- and I am super happy🥳😍 Great sound and screen, the cameras also amazing and captures best shots📸🏞️

              I have used all brands from Nokia to Apple. My majority mobiles was of Nokia, LG, Samsung, Motorola and Apple 5S.. Then One+ 3t, iPhone Xr and now from last 2 years with iPhone 12.

              I have bought Mi max, Vivo, Poco X3, Realme GT Neo 3 and Motorola g54 mobiles for my wife so far to play PUBG/BGMI often with my kids as well and now bought this Realme GT 6t🥳😁..

              I have used lots of mobile phones and now I can say this is the best, one can get under 31k price tag! If you get it lower than that, you’re damn lucky🥳😍😎🕺🏻…

              Note: The design, looks and colours are depends on individual tastes but, the mobile phone is definitely a power packed all rounder🔥🔥🔥

            About this Item

            • India's 1st 7+ Gen 3 Flagship Chipset 1.5M + AnTuTu Score,According to Qualcomm's official data, compared with Snapdragon 7+ Gen 2, CPU performance is increased by 15% and GPU performance is increased by 45%.
            • Top Battery Duo 50% Charge in 10 mins for 1-Day Use 5500mAh+120W Gallium Nitride Charger More compact in size for easy portability, with fast heat dissipation, while also offering high efficiency and high power fast charging.
            • India’s Largest Cooling System For your coolest gaming experience,To improve user thermal experience, efforts have been made in heat-generating chip layout and structural contact optimization, achieving a new generation of cooling design: effectively reducing temperature rise by 2 degrees on the side, achieving a low-temperature feel on the side frame. This results in a better sensory effect when holding.
            • The World's Brightest Flagship Display crystal clear visuals even in sunlight, 1.Uses AI models to analyze users' blinking and yawning frequency to identify fatigue, proactively adjusting color temperature and brightness for smart eye protection. 2.Eye Protection Certification: SGS AI Eye-Protection Display 3. Special Eye Protection: Paper-like eye protection, sleep mode, ambient color adaptation, DC dimming, comprehensive eye protection. Sleep mode: After sunset until before sunrise, the screen color temperature automatically adjusts to a warm hue, matching physiological rhythms to aid in sleep.
            • Segment's Only 8T LTPO,LTPO technology features adaptive frequency adjustment, allowing for frequency switching based on screen demand, lowering the refresh rate when displaying static content to reduce power consumption. The 8T LTPO technology, with its advanced pixel circuit design, achieves seamless frame rate transition, directly switching refresh rates to reduce flickering.
